title: AXI Safety: WLAST Exact Match
description: Toggle WLAST on accepted write-data beats while an accepted-AW queue derives each burst length and associates buffered early W transfers in AXI4 write-address order.

property.name: WLAST Exact Match
property.description: Each accepted AW creates an AWLEN+1 obligation. Accepted W transfers, including transfers buffered before AW, attach to those obligations in accepted AW order; checking both directions requires WLAST to be LOW before and HIGH on each obligation's final accepted beat.
property.svaString: accepted_aw_queue.push(AWID, AWLEN); assert ((WVALID && WREADY) |-> WLAST == (head.accepted_w_index == head.AWLEN));

waveform.title: Two AXI4 Writes: Dynamic AWLEN and W-before-AW
waveform.description: Two- and three-beat writes use different AWLEN values. In both transactions, the first W transfer is accepted before its AW and buffered until the accepted-address queue supplies association context.

annotations.message: A W transfer is accepted before AW. The subordinate must buffer it because AXI4 has no WID and the write-address-order context is not yet available.
AWID 4 is accepted with AWLEN=1. The buffered W transfer becomes beat 1 of this two-beat obligation.
The second accepted transfer must carry WLAST=1, completing AWID 4.
The first W transfer for the next write is accepted early and waits for the next accepted AW context.
AWID 9 with AWLEN=2 creates a three-beat obligation and claims the buffered transfer in AXI4 AW order.
WLAST is offered on the third beat, but WREADY is LOW. It is not counted yet and must remain stable.
The third transfer is accepted with WLAST=1, completing AWID 9.
